results.title: TC-GEO-1266-007 - An older analysis lists the same concepts with the same frequency as before the release
results.error: Frequency mismatch vs 2026-10-05 baseline on the Overview (13/13/6/6/4/4/3% observed vs 9/9/5/3/2/2/2% expected), but the baseline filters cannot be reproduced: analysis O scope changed after the baseline (Grok disabled -> toggle not selectable; category "Voitures électriques" no longer in the analysis). Root cause attributed to test data, not to GEO-1068.

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of analysis O with the baseline filters
steps.expected: The Top Concepts list is displayed
steps.observed: List displayed, but the baseline filters cannot be fully applied: period 28 Sept – 4 Oct 2026 and countries US/FR/ES set; AI engines limited to ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity because the Grok toggle is disabled (scope: grok isEnabled=false). The analysis now has 2 categories (Voitures hybrides, VUS) while the baseline XLSX had 3 (+ Voitures électriques).

steps.title: When the user compares the listed concepts with the baseline
steps.expected: The same 7 concepts are listed: Fiabilité, Efficacité énergétique, Leadership hybride, Usage urbain, Coûts d'entretien, Coût d'achat, Bruit à l'accélération; none added, none missing
steps.observed: Exactly the same 7 concepts, none added, none missing (All (7)).

steps.title: And the user compares the frequency % of each concept with the baseline
steps.expected: Fiabilité 9%, Efficacité énergétique 9%, Leadership hybride 5%, Usage urbain 3%, Coûts d'entretien 2%, Coût d'achat 2%, Bruit à l'accélération 2%
steps.observed: UI (3 engines): Fiabilité 13%, Efficacité énergétique 13%, Usage urbain 6%, Leadership hybride 6%, Coûts d'entretien 4%, Bruit à l'accélération 4%, Coût d'achat 3%. Read-only GET overview/top-concepts with llms incl. grok: 14/14/8/4/3/3/3%. Control: GET categories/Voitures hybrides/top-concepts incl. grok = 28/28/16/8/7/5/6% = exactly the baseline "Voitures hybrides" sheet -> per-category frequencies unchanged; the Overview drift matches the removal of a category from the scope (smaller denominator).

steps.title: And the user compares the polarity and the source count of each concept with the baseline
steps.expected: Coût d'achat is Mixed (8 sources), Bruit à l'accélération is Negative (7 sources), the 5 others are Positive (Fiabilité 23, Efficacité énergétique 29, Leadership hybride 17, Usage urbain 19, Coûts d'entretien 10 sources); each polarity is now stated by its label
steps.observed: All match: Coût d'achat 8 sources • Mixed, Bruit à l'accélération 7 sources • Negative, Fiabilité 23, Efficacité énergétique 29, Leadership hybride 17, Usage urbain 19, Coûts d'entretien 10 sources • Positive. Distribution 71% / 14% / 14% = baseline.

steps.title: Then only the display changed
steps.expected: Same concepts, frequency, polarity and source counts as the baseline; only the "{score} sentiment" text (e.g. "+86 sentiment") is gone
steps.observed: Concepts, polarity, source counts identical and score text gone; frequency identical at category level (API control) but not on the Overview because O's scope changed since the baseline. Overview frequency cannot be validated against this baseline.

results.notes: Red frames on step3_then = Overview frequency values differing from the baseline. Recommended: CSV/test-data adjustment - either compare on the category "Voitures hybrides" sheet (frequencies match) or take a new baseline of O / use an analysis whose scope has not changed. Ask who disabled Grok and removed "Voitures électriques" on O (QA-GEO).
